name: @lanka-playgrounds/svelte-kit
description: Atlas inside SvelteKit: a server load that scopes an instance per request, a hook that scopes the whole render, and a page hydrated from its data.

scripts.//dev: The application, against the API on port 4380. Start the server first.
scripts.//build:app: NOT `build`. `pnpm verify:build` is `pnpm -r run build` and it exists to check what is PUBLISHED.
scripts.//typecheck: `svelte-kit sync` first: Kit GENERATES `./.svelte-kit/tsconfig.json` and the `$app`/`./$types` modules a route imports, and without that step a typecheck reports every one of them as missing. It is codegen from this project, the same step `nuxt prepare` is next door.
